test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

During the summer of 1893, Miss Sullivan and I visited the World's Fair with Dr. Alexander Graham Bell. I recall with unmixed __delight__ those days when a thousand childish fancles became beautiful realities.
solution:
The correct answer is "**enchant.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Delight" means great pleasure, joy**.

 
 
• Example: He took great delight in telling your story.
 
 
 
• Enchant means to delight
